newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields to ease - central bank.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields to ease - central bank.

text.p: Yields on Ukraine's Treasury bill market are expected to fall gradually due to increased foreign buying on the market, the central bank chairman said.
"It goes without saying that wider participation by foreigners on the T-bill market will lead yields to correspond with the current refinancing rate," Viktor Yushchenko said late on Thursday.
The bank's refinancing rate, the rate which the central bank charges commercial banks for loans, has stood at 40 percent since July 2.
T-bill yields this week stood at 43.09 percent for three-month discount paper and 60.86 percent for 12-month discount paper, compared to more than 100 percent in June for discount bills.
The central bank recently clarified regulations for foreigners in order to increase their participation on the T-bill market. --Yuri Kulikov, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
